method: Artist-level editorial placement from playlist catalog context and known genre identity; all assignments are medium-confidence and explicitly best-effort.

A Capella Science.rationale: Original science songs use recognizable vocal-pop forms.

Aimee Carty.rationale: The lyric-led contemporary catalog is released and structured as pop.

Aldebert.rationale: The French singer-songwriter catalog is chanson and family pop.

Alex Melton.rationale: The catalog is built around guitar-led pop-punk and alternative-rock arrangements.

Alysha Brilla.rationale: The catalog centers melodic singer-songwriter pop with soul and global influences.

AMZY.rationale: The Denver band uses a conventional alternative-rock ensemble and catalog.

Ancient Mith.rationale: The Denver emcee's recordings are alternative and underground hip-hop.

Andy Sydow.rationale: The guitar-led catalog combines roots rock, blues, and Americana.

ARKA'N ASRAFOKOR.rationale: The Togolese band is a heavy-metal act using regional language and instrumentation.

Aron Ottignon.rationale: The pianist and composer's improvising catalog is contemporary jazz.

Arsenal Efectivo.rationale: The catalog is positively identified as regional Mexican music rather than generic US pop.

Ashenspire.rationale: The Scottish band is an avant-garde and black-metal rock ensemble.

Banda Cittá Ruvo Di Puglia.rationale: The ensemble performs regional Italian band repertoire in a traditional civic-band lineage.

Bandits Of The Acoustic Revolution.rationale: The ensemble is an acoustic extension of ska-punk and punk-rock practice.

Ben Caplan.rationale: Caplan's lyric-forward roots and folk songwriting maps to Modern Folk.

Ben Leinbach.rationale: The producer-led catalog centers ambient, yoga, and downtempo electronic production.

Ben Nobuto.rationale: Nobuto's composed chamber and orchestral work is contemporary classical.

Ben Zaidi.rationale: The catalog is lyric-led contemporary singer-songwriter music.

Bianca Mikahn.rationale: Mikahn's poetry, emcee delivery, and beat-based catalog map to Hip-hop.

Birdcloud.rationale: The duo's satirical songs use explicit country instrumentation and forms.

Blaggards.rationale: The Houston band's amplified Celtic repertoire maps to Rock.

Blood Cultures.rationale: The anonymous project's synth-led catalog is electronic pop.

Bone Orchard Revival.rationale: The acoustic roots and Americana catalog maps to Modern Folk.

Button Masher.rationale: The producer-composer uses chip synthesis and electronic game-music techniques.

Candelabro.rationale: The Chilean band's guitar-led catalog is experimental and art rock.

Catch Lungs.rationale: The Denver artist's catalog is rap and hip-hop.

Cathy Fink & Marcy Marxer.rationale: The duo performs old-time, bluegrass, and traditional American folk repertoire.

Church Fire.rationale: The Denver duo's synth and noise-driven catalog is industrial electronic music.

Cody Chesnutt.rationale: Chesnutt's vocal catalog is rooted in neo-soul, funk, and R&B.

corook.rationale: The contemporary singer-songwriter catalog is released and structured as indie pop.

Daby Touré.rationale: Touré's Mauritanian roots and West African guitar traditions provide positive regional World evidence.

Dark Dark Dark.rationale: The acoustic ensemble's accordion, banjo, and lyric-led catalog is indie folk.

Darren Korb.rationale: The playlist selections are composed narrative game scores; the taxonomy has no soundtrack family.

Dave McGraw and Crow Wing.rationale: The acoustic duo's roots songwriting maps to Modern Folk.

Devon Again.rationale: The vocal, hook-led catalog maps to alternative pop.

Deya Dova.rationale: The producer-led catalog combines electronic dance production with global vocal material.

Dirty Few.rationale: The Denver band's guitar-driven catalog is garage and party rock.

Elfin Saddle.rationale: The duo's found-object instrumentation and art practice are best represented by Experimental.

Everything Absent or Distorted.rationale: The Denver ensemble's catalog is guitar-led indie rock.

Faded Paper Figures.rationale: The synth-led indie catalog maps to Electronic.

Faraualla.rationale: The vocal quartet performs regional Italian and Mediterranean polyphonic traditions.

Frak.rationale: The Swedish group's analog-machine catalog is experimental electronic and techno.

Freddy Todd.rationale: The producer's bass-heavy, programmed catalog is glitch-hop and electronic music.

hemlocke springs.rationale: The hook-led, synth-backed catalog is indie and alternative pop.

Hensonn.rationale: The producer's beat-based catalog is phonk and electronic music.

Hey Marseilles.rationale: The Seattle chamber-pop ensemble retains a guitar-band indie-rock core.

Hola A Todo El Mundo.rationale: The Spanish band's catalog is indie and alternative rock.

Holly Near.rationale: Near's original topical and singer-songwriter catalog maps to Modern Folk.

Honningbarna.rationale: The Norwegian cello-led band is explicitly a punk-rock act.

Hughes De Courson.rationale: The French producer's projects explicitly combine regional traditional repertoires across cultures.

Ian Cooke.rationale: Cooke's cello-led singer-songwriter work maps to Modern Folk.

Idris Ackamoor.rationale: The saxophonist and Pyramids founder's improvising catalog is spiritual jazz.

illuminati hotties.rationale: The guitar-band catalog is indie, punk, and alternative rock.

itchy-O.rationale: The large-format percussion and electronic performance ensemble maps to Experimental.

Jape.rationale: The Irish project combines electronic production with indie songwriting.

JD McPherson.rationale: McPherson's guitar-led catalog is explicitly rock and roll and roots rock.

Jetta.rationale: The British singer's hook-led contemporary catalog maps to alternative pop.

Joey Pecoraro.rationale: The producer-led instrumental catalog uses sampled beats and electronic production.

Judy Small.rationale: Small's original topical singer-songwriter catalog maps to Modern Folk.

Katey Laurel.rationale: The acoustic, lyric-led catalog maps to Modern Folk.

Kathryn Joseph.rationale: Joseph's piano-and-voice, lyric-led work maps to Modern Folk.

Kayhan Kalhor.rationale: Kalhor's Iranian kamancheh repertoire provides positive regional World evidence.

Kim And Reggie Harris.rationale: The duo performs spirituals, freedom songs, and traditional folk repertoire.

Kirin J Callinan.rationale: The Australian guitarist's catalog is art and experimental rock.

Klaus Badelt.rationale: The playlist selections are composed orchestral screen scores.
